title: R6 Voice and Phone Transaction Workflow evidence ready for manager review
summary: Separate telephony transport state from booking/business outcome; a completed call is not booking evidence.
Preserve and machine-enforce the beta's bounded authorization and fresh-approval barrier for material changes.
Require counterparty verification plus purpose/necessity checks before sensitive identifier disclosure.
Default away from raw-audio retention; recording/transcription requires jurisdiction-aware notice, purpose, consent and retention review.
Ambiguous post-action disconnects must block blind retries and enter reconciliation to prevent duplicate bookings.
Persist structured authorization, disclosure, call-event and booking-confirmation evidence without duplicating raw sensitive identifiers into general logs.
dependencies_and_escalations: R4 should reconcile exact booking confirmation semantics.
R5/qualified review should resolve jurisdiction-specific recording/privacy applicability.
R9 should define callback/counterparty identity and authentication controls.
R10 should define adapter/webhook security, replay handling and event reconciliation.
